rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, LAMC Ch. XV
rules.conflict_note: No ordinance number cited.

rules.title: LA RSO: additional tenant/dependent rent increase
rules.requirement: Since 2026-02-02, no 10% increase for an added dependent; a 10% increase for an additional non-dependent tenant is still allowed if imposed within 60 days of the landlord learning of the tenant.
rules.key_value: 10% for additional non-dependent tenant; 0% for dependents
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO units in Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Occupant dependent status and notice timing.

rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, LAMC Ch. XV

rules.title: LA RSO legal reasons for eviction and no-fault relocation
rules.requirement: RSO tenants may be evicted only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons; no-fault evictions require relocation assistance and LAHD filings.
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO units in Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit subject to RSO.

rules.conflict_note: State just cause yields to this local ordinance.

rules.title: LA RSO security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units must pay tenants interest on security deposits at the city's annually set rate, monthly or yearly, by payment or rent credit, with written notice of the method.
rules.key_value: Annual city-set rate (4.320% for 2025); paid monthly or yearly
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO units in Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit subject to RSO.

rules.conflict_note: Code text quoted via landlord-association source; 2026 rate not in corpus. Effective date is the interest accrual start date.

rules.title: Relocation assistance and Declaration of Intent to Evict for no-fault evictions (RSO & JCO)
rules.requirement: Before a no-fault eviction from an RSO or JCO unit, the landlord must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD and pay relocation within 15 days of serving notice (or escrow).
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO or JCO units terminated for no-fault reasons; higher amounts for qualified tenants (62+, disabled, minor children).
rules.exemptions: Resident manager replacement; natural-disaster hazards not caused by landlord; reduced amounts for Mom and Pop properties and natural-person SFDs under JCO.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: RSO/JCO coverage; tenant age/disability/children, tenancy length, income.

rules.conflict_note: Effective date reflects the current amount schedule; amounts adjust every July 1.

rules.title: Permitted no-fault eviction grounds under RSO and JCO
rules.requirement: No-fault evictions are limited to enumerated grounds: owner/relative/resident-manager occupancy; demolition, conversion, or removal from rental use (Ellis for RSO); government vacate orders; HUD sale; and others listed.
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO (LAMC 151.09.A) and JCO (LAMC 165.03) units.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit covered by RSO or JCO.

rules.title: Reduced relocation for Mom and Pop properties (owner/family occupancy)
rules.requirement: Small landlords may pay reduced relocation for good-faith owner or relative occupancy evictions if the building has four or fewer units, the provision was not used in the prior three years, and ownership limits are met.
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO/JCO units in buildings of 4 or fewer units owned by qualifying small landlords.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Landlord owns no more than 4 units plus one SFD in the City; not used in prior 3 years; relative owns no LA residential property.

rules.conflict_note: Effective date reflects current amount schedule.

rules.title: JCO single-family dwellings owned by natural persons: one month's rent relocation
rules.requirement: For a JCO single-family dwelling owned by a qualifying natural person, no-fault relocation is one month's rent in effect when notice was served.
rules.coverage_conditions: JCO single-family dwellings owned by qualifying natural persons.
rules.exemptions: LAMC 151.30(E) does not apply.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Owner is a natural person (or controlled trust/entity) owning no more than 4 units plus one SFD in the City.

rules.title: Resident Protections Ordinance: enhanced relocation for lower-income tenants displaced by demolition
rules.requirement: Owners demolishing a Protected Unit for new construction must pay lower-income (80% AMI or below) households enhanced relocation; all tenants still receive at least RSO/JCO amounts within 15 days.
rules.coverage_conditions: Protected Units (all RSO units; units rent-controlled, affordability-restricted, or rented to lower-income households in past 5 years; Ellis-withdrawn in past 10 years) demolished for new construction.
rules.exemptions: Above-low-income households receive regular RSO/JCO amounts.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Protected Unit status; demolition for new construction; household income.

rules.citation: Los Angeles Ordinance Nos. 188481 and 188482; Cal. Gov. Code § 66300.6
rules.conflict_note: State Housing Crisis Act independently requires enhanced relocation for lower-income tenants.

rules.title: Los Angeles motion to study a ban on algorithmic rent-setting software (CF 24-1031)
rules.requirement: Motion instructs LAHD to report on use of algorithm-based rent-setting software and feasibility of a ban; it imposes no ban. Not law.
rules.coverage_conditions: Ownership and management entities in Los Angeles (proposed study scope).
rules.citation: Los Angeles City Council File 24-1031 (Motion, Sept. 3, 2024)
rules.conflict_note: Feasibility motion only; subsequent action not in corpus. State AB 325 applies statewide.
